actions.ask-cometapi.description: Sends a prompt to any AI model supported by CometAPI.
actions.ask-cometapi.props.maxTokens.des: Maximum number of tokens to generate.
actions.ask-cometapi.props.prompt.descri: The prompt to send to the AI model.
actions.ask-cometapi.props.systemMessage: Optional system message to set the behavior of the AI.
actions.ask-cometapi.props.temperature.d: Controls randomness (0-2). Lower values make output more focused.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
auth.description:
Follow these instructions to get your CometAPI Key:

1. Visit the CometAPI Dashboard: https://api.cometapi.com/console/token
2. Go to the API settings page to get your key.
3. Copy the key and paste it below.
description: Access multiple AI models through CometAPI - unified interface for GPT, Claude, Gemini, and more.
